meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: Urban co-operative banks' priority-sector advances by sector, to March 2026
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 810, the Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks' Outlook (statistical table), read from the local Data Bank mirror. Provisional, as the source marks every row. ₹ crore. Micro and small enterprises became micro, small and medium enterprises in the table's own labels; kept as two series.
